About.title: About Us
About.intro_text: Wallah We Can is a Tunisian association created in 2012. The association strives to guarantee children equitable access to education, an environment conducive to learning, and a decent living framework. It implements sustainable, economic, and ecological solutions, ensuring children a fairer and more equitable development and fulfillment.
About.mission_title: Because committing to childhood today is investing in the adults of tomorrow.

Hero.headline: Make the school a driver of impact
Hero.p1: Since 2012, Wallah We Can has been developing entrepreneurial and ecological solutions to improve children's living and learning conditions. With GreenSchool, we implemented an innovative model in a boarding middle school in Makthar (Siliana governorate), based on energy autonomy and food self-sufficiency.
Hero.p2: The generated benefits are reinvested in school infrastructure and educational activities, while creating jobs for parents—in the fields, kitchens or maintenance—thus strengthening local impact in solidarity.

Pillars.title: One school, four pillars of change
Pillars.subtitle: To become a GreenSchool, each institution can engage in a labeling process around 4 essential axes, aligned with the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):

health.title: Student Health
health.description: Ensure access to quality care and promote healthy lifestyle habits for all students.

education.title: Inclusive Education
education.description: Offer a learning environment adapted to each child's needs, fostering personal development.

food.title: Sustainable Food
food.description: Develop a self-sufficient school canteen producing nutritious and environmentally friendly meals.

energy.title: Renewable Energy
energy.description: Implement clean and sustainable energy solutions for the institution's autonomy.

Pillars.conclusion: The GreenSchool pillars are designed to address major challenges of the Tunisian education system while creating a model of an autonomous and sustainable school that can be replicated elsewhere.

Hero.tagline: A social and solidarity economy model to fight malnutrition in schools
Hero.approachParagraph: By applying a social and solidarity economy model, Wallah We Can offers a sustainable solution to fight malnutrition in schools by making them self-sufficient in food. We trained unemployed parents in sustainable agriculture, employed them to cultivate 8 hectares of land. The fruits and vegetables grown and harvested are distributed directly to school canteens. The surplus production is then marketed to self-finance the project.

Hero.subtitle: The story of how a simple discovery sparked a movement for menstrual justice in Tunisia and beyond.
Hero.originParagraph: It was when we saw some of the mattresses in the girls’ dorms at the Makthar boarding school, that we discovered the reality of period poverty. Many of the girls were using foam from their mattresses as menstrual protection.
Hero.inspirationalQuote: From a simple discovery to a global movement.

Media.aboutText: Wallah We Can, founded by Lotfi Hamadi, is a Tunisian association that revolutionizes education and child protection through sustainable, innovative solutions. From the Green School project, a self-sufficient boarding school providing energy and food, to Ecolibree, a program against period poverty, to Wallah We Care for health access and the Children's Embassy defending children's rights, each initiative aims to build a fairer future. These actions, praised by national and international media, put youth at the heart of change.

Intro.description: Each year, Wallah We Can organizes an event that brings together members of the nobility and the international jet set, as well as prestigious brands such as Dior, Dolce & Gabbana, or Chopard. WWC intends to make these guests the ambassadors of our solutions for childhood around the world.

GalaDior.title: A Prestigious Gala with Maison Dior
GalaDior.p1: The Génération Liberté association, which hosted the Wallah We Can initiative in its early years, organized a charity gala on May 31, 2014, at Dar Kamila, the residence of the French Ambassador to Tunisia, with the support of the Dior fashion house.
GalaDior.p2: This event was organized to raise funds to transform the Makthar boarding school. Indeed, this establishment was in a very poor state, with very few financial resources and educational tools: this establishment offered no comfort to the students. Guaranteeing that every student studies in comfortable conditions, while ensuring the right to education, to health, to physical and legal protection, and to fulfillment: these are the objectives of WWC's actions.

International.title: Wallah We Can International
International.description: In 2021, we celebrated the launch of Wallah We Can International at the Senate, Palais du Luxembourg: from now on, WWC is present in France, Belgium, England, Germany, Algeria, Luxembourg, Canada, Mexico, and the United States.
